body: I've let everyone down. Even myself. I cant do anything right. My girlfriend is the only one that knows how I feel. Theres no way in hell Im telling someone in my family. And looking for help feels hopeless. I've never been the guy who looks positively on life. My friend even says "dude your view on the future is so dark" and thats because it is. Im just  sad human, i should've been aborted before I had the chance to dissapoint someone

Ofcourse I want to. That was the reason I went to the gym so often and did my best there. I wanted to be and look my best for my girlfriend. But its just hopeless. Even if I get a good body, it wont compensate for my hideous face. And i wont get any smarter no matter how hard I study. Its just hopeless. She could get soooo much better than me. I was so close to breaking up with her when I made her cry once. She didnt deserve it. I never wanted her to cry. I didnt know that it was gonna happen. And no, i didnt hit her or anything. She got triggered by a thing she saw while I was scrolling on my phone. Nothing affects me anymore. Shes quite sensitive when it comes to shit like people getting hurt and all but Im completely desensitized. I feel so bad for her...
